product_metadata.title: MARATHON Compact Alarm Clock with Temperature & Date, French Blue - Large, Easy to Read Display with Backlight - Easy to Set Up & Use - Two AAA Batteries Included
features: LIGHTWEIGHT, COMPACT CLOCK - Sized at 3x1.2x3 inches and weighing just 0.25 pounds, this clock is designed to fit anywhere and is perfect for travel. Choose from black, white, blue, gold, graphite gray, green, orange, pink, or silver.

INFORMATIVE DISPLAY - The easy-to-ready display includes the time in 12- or 24-hour format, the temperature in Celcius or Farenheit, and the month, date & day in English, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Italian or Spanish.

ONE-TOUCH BACKLIGHT - Simply press the button on the back of the clock to activate the cool blue backlight for five seconds at a time. It provides maximum illumination in darker environments, without being too harsh on the eyes.
LOUD ALARM - Easy to set up and use, the alarm is loud & clear with a progressive interval ring.

FAMILY OWNED & OPERATED - Marathon has been manufacturing precision timing instruments since 1939. Today, they continue their legacy, combining modern design sensibility with Swiss engineering & craftsmanship.
